purpose: Live production RDKit C++ FFI ground truth (oxirane_ring_count, reactive_amine_hydrogen_count) for 6 guanidine/amidine-class probes, to be diffed against role-flory-gelation-v1's local Python SMARTS re-derivation for the same SMILES.

results.citation: 1,3-diphenylguanidine (DPG, CAS 102-06-7). Same molecule as role-guanidine-accelerator-domain-probe-v1's already-ledgered probe.
N,N'-di-o-tolylguanidine (DOTG, CAS 97-39-2). Same molecule as role-guanidine-accelerator-domain-probe-v1's already-ledgered probe.
Guanidine (CAS 113-00-8), the parent Y-delocalized structure; pinned regression control in amphora-rdkit-ffi::pinned_native_backend_excludes_guanidine_class_amine_hydrogens.
Biguanide (CAS 56-03-1), same pinned regression control set.

Dicyandiamide / cyanoguanidine (DICY, CAS 461-58-5), the sole named carve-out (W-FFI2, WO1993010168A1): a real functionality-4 stoichiometric hardener whose cyanamide-substituted imine nitrogen breaks the symmetric resonance the guanidine exclusion relies on.
N-methylguanidine: adversarial narrowness control from the pinned amphora-rdkit-ffi test suite -- imine-N alkyl substituent, no nitrile, must stay excluded (reactive_amine_hydrogen_count == 0).
